mechanism: Chlorpromazine may impair gastrointestinal motility and reduce risedronate absorption, while both drugs can increase fall risk through different mechanisms (bisphosphonate-associated atypical fractures and antipsychotic CNS effects).
action: Separate administration by at least 30 minutes, ensure adequate hydration, monitor for gastrointestinal symptoms, and assess fall risk regularly given dual CNS and skeletal effects.
